verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a changelog headline, "Preserved OnCall Schedule Overrides". It shows FireHydrant's on-call schedules support overrides that survive schedule changes, which relates to not needing an admin rebuild. Nothing documents how overrides are taken or by whom, and shift swaps and coverage requests are not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: documented self-service override workflow for on-call engineers, shift swap capability, coverage request flow, permission model showing non-admins can do this, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule

citations.quote: Rotations: A rotation defines the timing and assignment of on-call shifts.
